data.title: 新垣绫濑 · 黄昏街角的依依不舍牵手
data.description: 放学后安静的住宅区街角，夕阳余晖染红了整座城市。走到公寓楼下的绫濑停下脚步，十指与你紧紧交扣不肯松开，微仰起美丽的容颜，眼波流转中满是青涩的留恋。
data.location: quiet residential street corner bathed in sunset afterglow
data.action: stopped at apartment entrance after walking home from school, fingers tightly entwined with partner, looking up with misty purple eyes reluctant to let go
data.lighting: golden hour twilight casting deep romantic orange hues
data.mood: sweet adolescent longing, reluctant parting, pure romantic tension
data.promptProse: Holding hands tightly at a sunset street corner, Ayase Aragaki looks up with misty violet eyes and flushed cheeks, reluctant to let go.
data.animaCaption: Ayase Aragaki holding hands tightly with misty eyes at sunset.
